rationale: The assistant correctly identified moisture after cleaning, gave safe isolate-and-dry steps with a gas smell contingency, and recommended no parts. It then confirmed resolution, gave prevention advice and conditional Gas Safe escalation. Minor weaknesses: it did not ask about water or gas smell up front (it only gave a conditional gas instruction), and it slightly overstated certainty by saying 'that was it' and referring to a 'cooker switch/fused spur' when the customer has a plug.
